cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: One Thing Leads to Another
cards.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. This café chair wobbles. Let's take all the chairs apart and check their joints.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I tested them. It's only this chair, on this floorboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then we'll lift the floorboards. The chairs have exposed a flooring problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll close for renovations. Once the floor's up, we can move the counter and sort out the queue.

mechanism: A grants repair and closure decisions that transform a single wobbly chair into a wider cafe renovation.
confusable: Selling a disaster rationalizes a bad plan; D48 specifically uses each smaller problem to justify a broader disruptive solution.
comparison: A cafe opening deadline is sacrificed for floor and counter work, unlike a domestic washer leading to kitchen redesign.
seedUse: Use D48-b isolated floorboard and imminent opening; S01 permission should authorize progressively larger disruption from those facts.
